main.description: One friend watering another's plant — written to the TENDER's repo (rkey tid), naming the farm owner (subject) and the plant. Growth math counts DISTINCT friends per plant: each cuts total growth time 10%, capped at five (50%). Both sides are public records, so the boost is verifiable by anyone recomputing growthOf(). Clients honour a courtesy budget of 3 tends per friend per day; the records make overspending auditable rather than enforceable.

plantId.description: The plant id inside the subject's plot record.

verb.description: Flavour of the tend (mechanically identical in v1).
